notes: Parity on the 11-task subset (5%, stratified by use case, --split parity), agreed with the Harbor team. Both sides: Harbor 0.27.0 (latest release), claude-code 2.1.330 installed by Harbor's claude-code install step, model claude-haiku-5-5 (the model's canonical ID; it has no dated variant, and every request in the claude-code logs reports it), Harbor's claude-code flags and environment with host overrides unset, instruction.md unchanged on stdin, 3600 s agent limit and resources from task.toml, 8 concurrent trials, Daytona sandboxes, gateway https://app.ppapi.ai. Both sides are graded by the same fork grader commit e287476 (upstream 8b71342 plus a judge-compatibility change in judges.py) and the same cheap judge panel (claude-haiku-5-5, gemini-3.8-flash, gpt-6-luna) with upstream eval.example.yaml settings; scores are not comparable with the upstream leaderboard. Order: 5-query sanity run on both sides, counted toward run 1, then the rest of run 1, then runs 2 and 3. All agent runs ended with claude-code status success and a report; no run was rerun, and every query was graded by all three judges. Metric: upstream macro_avg_qualification_rate_on_all_queries on the original side, Harbor mean reward on the Harbor side (the same quantity), as fractions. The original-side runs are the second set, run after the original side's install step was changed to Harbor's exact command (apt-get update && apt-get install -y nodejs npm procps; fork commit ada6995). A first set of three original-side runs with --no-install-recommends (0.3868, 0.4017, 0.2734; 0.3540 ± 0.0405) also overlapped the Harbor runs and is kept in the fork's records; it is not used here. Paired per-task difference (Harbor minus original, mean over runs): +0.026, 95% CI [-0.027, +0.079] over the 11 tasks.
